class.name: VehicleAerodynamicsData
class.brief_description: A resource that defines aerodynamic properties: drag and downforce.
class.description: VehicleAerodynamicsData configures aerodynamic drag and downforce. Drag opposes vehicle velocity; downforce grows with squared speed. Optional yaw stabilization is configured separately through [ESCData].

members.member: Aerodynamic drag coefficient (Cd). Higher values increase air resistance at speed.
Downforce coefficient. Multiplied by dynamic pressure and frontal area to produce aerodynamic downforce at speed.
